headline: GEO Group to Activate Texas Immigration Center Under ICE Deal
summary: GEO Group is set to activate a Texas immigration facility under an agreement with Immigration and Customs Enforcement.
why: Government contracts for detention and immigration facilities can provide stable, recurring revenue streams for private prison operators.

impacts.name: GEO Group
impacts.why: Government facility activation agreements secure operational revenue and contract renewals for private corrections firms.
